title: ocotea valerioana
intro: Ocotea valerioana, commonly known as Costa Rican valeriana or "Costa Rican valerian", is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Ocotea valerioana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including valeranone, valerenic acid, and isovaleric acid, which are known to interact with the GABA receptor and modulate the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Ocotea valerioana may also exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, although further research is needed to confirm these effects.
